data.name: Aashutosh Ajay Sharma
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Aashutosh Ajay Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 72 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 63, with an average of 16.46 and a quick strike rate of 124.09. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 18 sixes and 93 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 18.2 overs, taking 8 wickets at an economy rate of 11.40. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
